summary: Core Booking Service business logic implemented across all hexagonal layers: domain (entities, value objects incl. NIK with no plaintext leak, event-sourcing events), ports (inbound usecases + outbound repos/UoW/stores), postgres adapters (event_repo, admission_repo with batch reserve, booking_repo, ticket/quota/attendee repos, idempotency store, outbox writer, unit_of_work with Hold/ReplaceItems/Settle/Expire enforcing the fixed supply->category->quota->booking lock order + event-store append + read-model projection + outbox), security (NIK protector + EdDSA token verifiers), payment client, rabbitmq payment consumer + outbox relay, HTTP handlers (catalog, session, booking, attendee, my-bookings, internal allocations), workers (session sweeper, expiry sweeper, outbox relay) wired into delivery.

verification.testRace: PASS (15 packages, no failures, go test -race -count=1 ./...)
verification.lint: PASS for all new code; 3 remaining golangci issues are in pre-existing boilerplate (cmd/migrate.go errcheck, config/{config,load}.go Indonesian-word 'variabel' misspell false positives) unmodified by this work

invariants.noOversell: Enforced by DB CHECKs inside unit_of_work.Hold; lock order supply->category->quota->booking; retry on eventstore.ErrConcurrency (max 3)
invariants.janganPHP: allocate_batch reserves admission atomically per batch, idempotent per queue_entry_id
invariants.sessionTTL: payment_expires_at from admission snapshot; ReplaceItems never resets it
invariants.settlementAtomicity: Settle guarded by status!=PAID + ON CONFLICT on tickets (idempotent)

notImplemented: SSE streaming endpoint (Task 7 stream) + availability cache (Valkey)
Reconciliation worker (Task 11 AC11.7), metrics endpoint (Task 14 AC14.4)
Integration tests (build tag 'integration') require live PG/RabbitMQ not available in this env; unit tests with hand-written fakes cover the decision logic
